description: Ranked candidates with stable workspace-qualified locators. One query term is one td search invocation, and the order td returned is the order emitted: a title hit above two description hits, the P1 task above the P3 chore on the priority tie-break. Every locator and candidate names the workspace without exposing an absolute root, and source_revision fingerprints the exact listing bytes that answered.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
